name: robots/aurelienroy__ardupilot_sitl_gazebo_plugin
title: ArduPilot SITL Gazebo plugin (ROS 1 surface)
intro: ArduPilot SITL Gazebo plugin (ROS 1 surface), adapted from aurelienroy/ardupilot_sitl_gazebo_plugin. It reads `observe_motor_speed`; runs `take_lapse_lock` and `release_lapse_lock`. `take_lapse_lock`: take the plugin's bounded wall-time lapse lock with the upstream method default horizon of 1 s; this pauses the plugin loop that steps the paused Gazebo world and exchanges packets with ArduPilot SITL, not ArduPilot itself, and the plugin clears the lock automatically when the timer expires. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
